mentions.title: King bearing defect??
mentions.snippet: Thread titled as a suspected King bearing defect on the AMC Forum. No detail beyond the title was visible in the search result, so the nature and severity of the claimed defect is unconfirmed. First time this thread has appeared in the scan.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: Poster reports King STDX thrust bearings measured over 1mm too narrow to fit BMW S85 and S65 blocks, seen across multiple sets and multiple blocks, and concludes King main bearings should not be used on those engines. Search snippet also indicates a King tech support employee confirmed 2024 main thrust bearings were out of spec and advised against use.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread on King main thrust bearings. Snippet describes a 2024 King main found out of spec on 'free spread' and a 2025 main also reported bad, raising doubts about the manufacturing process, though other posters report using King mains since 2024 without issue.

mentions.title: King Bearing - lack of professional help for quality control problem
mentions.snippet: Customer reports an unopened King XP series package containing the wrong assortment of sizes (8x .011 uppers, 7x .011 lowers, 1x .030 lower), and says King directed them back to their supplier rather than replacing it. Complaint is about both quality control and service response.

mentions.title: No more King XP bearings
mentions.snippet: Thread title states the poster is done with King XP bearings; snippet from the same search indicates a user traced a bottom-end problem to bearing delamination on King bearings. A King representative has replied in the thread.
mentions.replyNote: Re-confirmed after last run's timeout: an official King Bearings representative replied near the end of the thread, noting it was an older thread recently brought to their attention and offering to investigate the specific bearings if details were provided.
